RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have activated the online application link for RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 under CEN 08/2026. The RRB Recruitment 2026 Apply Online link is active, and eligible candidates can complete their registration or login to submit the application before the deadline.

How to Apply Online for RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026?
Visit the official website rrbapply.gov.in .
Open the RRB recruitment application portal.
Select the Station Master recruitment under CEN 08/2026 .
Click on Create an Account for new registration or Already Have an Account to log in.
Complete the required account verification and enter personal details.
Fill in educational qualifications and applicable category details.
Select the Railway Recruitment Board and available Railway preferences carefully.
Capture the required live photograph and upload the signature and applicable documents according to the portal instructions.
Review all entered details and submit the application form.
Pay the applicable examination fee through the online payment facility.
Download or print the completed application form for future reference.
Important: Candidates must apply to only one RRB. Multiple applications may result in rejection. Account creation details and the chosen RRB cannot be changed during the correction window.
Candidates who have already created an account can use the official RRB Apply Login facility to access their application. New candidates must complete account registration before filling out the Station Master form.
Use the registered account credentials and follow the authentication instructions displayed on the official portal. Candidates should keep their registered mobile number and email address accessible.

RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 - FAQs
Q1. Is the RRB Recruitment 2026 Apply Online link activated?
Yes. The RRB Station Master online application link is active at rrbapply.gov.in. Candidates can apply until 25 November 2026.
Q2. How can I apply online for RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026?
Visit https://www.rrbapply.gov.in/, register or log in, select CEN 08/2026, complete the application form and pay the required examination fee.
Q3. What is the official website for RRB Recruitment 2026?
The official Railway Recruitment Boards website is rrb.indianrailways.gov.in. The official online application portal is rrbapply.gov.in.
Q4. How do I access rrbapply.gov.in login?
Open rrbapply.gov.in and select the existing account login option. Enter your registered credentials and complete the required authentication to access your application.
Q5. What is the last date to apply for RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026?
The last date to submit the online application is 25 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Q6. How many vacancies are available in RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026?
A total of 1265 Station Master vacancies have been announced under CEN 08/2026, as corrected by Corrigendum No. 1.
Q7. What is the qualification for RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026?
Candidates must have a Bachelor's Degree or equivalent qualification from a recognized university.
Q8. What is the age limit for RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026?
The age limit is 20 to 33 years as on 01 January 2027, with applicable relaxation for eligible categories.
Q9. What is the salary for an RRB Station Master?
The initial basic salary is Rs. 35,400 per month under Level 6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, excluding applicable allowances.
Q10. Can I apply for more than one RRB under CEN 08/2026?
No. Candidates must submit only one application to one selected RRB. Multiple applications may lead to rejection.
